title: Pinto bean and sweetcorn stew
summary: Pinto bean and sweetcorn stew is a mexican dinner built around canned pinto beans and canned sweetcorn, with the portions weighed so each serving stays under 700 kcal.

steps.instruction: Warm the oil and soften the onion for Pinto bean and sweetcorn stew. Stir in the garlic, ginger and spices until they smell fragrant.
steps.tip: If the spices look dusty, give them a minute in the oil before any liquid goes in.

steps.instruction: Add canned pinto beans and cook until it loses its raw look. Pour in the tomatoes or coconut and canned sweetcorn.
Simmer gently, lid ajar, until onions is tender and the sauce coats a spoon. Add a splash of water if it sticks.
steps.tip: Taste Pinto bean and sweetcorn stew before serving and add a squeeze of lemon if it wants brightness.

steps.instruction: Taste for salt and acid, then rest the pan for a couple of minutes before serving Pinto bean and sweetcorn stew.  Serve with the quinoa, simmered in salted water until tender.
